generation_supplier.notes: Could not confirm during this collection pass. No official source was found stating whether the City of Fresno has an operational Community Choice Aggregator (CCA). This is absence-of-evidence across secondary sources, not a direct official 'no CCA' statement — needs verification via CPUC's CCA service-area map or a City of Fresno utilities communication before recording a value.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Fresno/Fresno County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

value.name: SGIP - Equity Resiliency
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Incentive of $1,000/kWh for IOU residential or non-residential customers. Source states this rate is/was 'available through 2025.'
value.eligibility: IOU residential or non-residential customers meeting Equity Resiliency criteria (e.g. high fire-threat district, medical baseline). Specific Fresno County eligibility not independently confirmed this session.

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC/PG&E-administered SGIP program and figures already confirmed for the San Jose/Fremont/Oakland pilot records, reused here on the same reasoning: SGIP is administered per IOU distribution territory (PG&E), not per city, and PG&E's distribution role in Fresno is independently confirmed (S3). Confidence held at 0.65 since this record does not independently re-confirm PG&E's SGIP administrator role specifically for Fresno County. 'Available through 2025' read as expiring 2025-12-31 (no specific day stated), which is before last_verified, hence 'expired'; the other tier's reservation-opening date is directly stated with no stated end/status, hence 'unknown'. Re-check against selfgenca.com's live Program Metrics page before showing as current.

value.name: SolarAPP+ approval confirmation
value.required_when: SolarAPP+-eligible residential rooftop systems (single-family and duplex only)

required_documents.notes: Only the SolarAPP+ confirmation-upload step was explicitly and consistently described across independent sources (contractor submits project details to SolarAPP+, then uploads the resulting confirmation to the city's Accela Citizens Access system as proof of code compliance). A dedicated 'Residential Solar Plan Check Submittal' PDF exists on fresno.gov (referenced by title in search results) but could not be directly fetched this session to confirm its specific document checklist — not listed here to avoid inventing items not directly confirmed.

inspection_steps.notes: No specific inspection-scheduling procedure (comparable to Fremont's municipal-code text or Oakland's mobile-app process) was found in the sources reviewed this session; fresno.gov could not be directly fetched to check further.

value.notes: Multiple independent sources consistently describe SolarAPP+-eligible residential (single-family/duplex) solar permits in Fresno as issued 'in real time' once the contractor uploads the SolarAPP+ confirmation to the city's Accela system — i.e. same-day/immediate issuance. No source found states a timeline for the standard (non-SolarAPP+, e.g. commercial) permit path.

other_conditions: Contractor must be licensed and registered as a SolarAPP+ installer
Confirmation must be uploaded to the City's Accela Citizens Access (ACA) electronic permitting system
Commercial solar installations do not qualify for SolarAPP+ and must use the standard permit process

permit_fees.notes: Not stated in any source reviewed this session.

rebates.notes: No Fresno-specific rebate program found this session, distinct from the statewide SGIP battery incentives already recorded under battery_programs.
